component.name: Halo
component.summary: Your Ring cameras and home security on the Linux desktop

description.p: See your cameras, review events and manage supported Ring devices in a native GTK interface that fits your Linux desktop.

ul.li: Camera previews, focused live view and multi-camera monitoring
Listening and deliberate push-to-talk with Ring privacy checks
Event history, downloads, screenshots and Favorites
Alarm observations and supported device controls
Desktop notifications with quiet hours and per-device rules

description.p: A Ring account and compatible hardware are required. Available features depend on the device, account permissions and Ring services.
